```yaml
name: Lint ObjC New Usage

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - '**.m'
      - '**.mm'
      - '**.h'

jobs:
  lint-objc-new:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check for [ClassName new] usage
        run: |
          # Find all Objective-C source files
          OBJC_FILES=$(find . -type f \( -name "*.m" -o -name "*.mm" -o -name "*.h" \) -not -path "./Pods/*" -not -path "./.build/*" -not -path "./vendor/*")
          
          if [ -z "$OBJC_FILES" ]; then
            echo "No Objective-C files found."
            exit 0
          fi

          # Search for patterns like [ClassName new] or [self new] or [super new]
          # We look for 'new]' preceded by a bracket and identifier to catch [Class new]
          # This regex looks for [ <identifier> new ]
          MATCHES=$(grep -rnE '\[[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*\s+new\]' $OBJC_FILES || true)

          if [ -n "$MATCHES" ]; then
            echo "::error::Found usage of [ClassName new] which should be replaced with [[ClassName alloc] init]."
            echo "$MATCHES"
            exit 1
          else
            echo "No violations found."
          fi
```
